info.name: Developer Assessment Platform API
info.description:
End-to-end Postman collection for the Developer Assessment & Coding Platform (B7A6 backend assignment). Folders are ordered to be run top-to-bottom with Postman's Collection Runner: Auth -> Users -> Company -> Candidate -> Problem -> Assessment -> Invitation -> Attempt -> Evaluation -> Result -> Payment -> Notification -> Admin -> Error Demos -> Wrap-up.

Uses Bearer-token auth (captured automatically from the `set-auth-token` response header on login — see collection variables) rather than cookies, so it works identically whether Postman's cookie jar is enabled or not, and so three roles (Admin / Recruiter / Candidate) can be active side by side without clobbering each other's session.

Before running: set adminEmail/adminPassword to your SUPER_ADMIN_EMAIL/PASSWORD, and confirm candidate1/candidate2 credentials match your seed.ts demo accounts.

request.description: Basic liveness + DB connectivity check. Not under /api/v1.
Creates a brand-new CANDIDATE account (role is server-assigned, cannot be set by the client). Uses a timestamped email so this is safely re-runnable.
Fill adminEmail/adminPassword collection variables with your SUPER_ADMIN_EMAIL / SUPER_ADMIN_PASSWORD from .env before running.
This seeded CANDIDATE will register a company later in this collection, which promotes them to RECRUITER. Kept as its own token throughout so later requests don't need to re-login.
This is the candidate seeded with a completed, graded attempt already in the DB (see seed.ts) — useful for GET endpoints even before you run the live attempt flow below.

// All three submissions (MCQ auto + these two manual) are now COMPLETED,

item.name: Stripe Webhook (not called directly from Postman)

body.raw: { "note": "Stripe signs this body — it cannot be hand-constructed in Postman." }

request.description:
This endpoint requires a valid Stripe signature over the raw request body, which only Stripe (or the Stripe CLI) can produce. To exercise it locally:

  stripe listen --forward-to localhost:5000/api/v1/webhooks/stripe

then complete a checkout session above using Stripe's test card. Do not send this request from Postman as-is — it will fail signature verification by design (that's the security control working correctly).
Should include a 'Result Published' notification once the Evaluate Written Submission call above finalizes the attempt's Result.
Demonstrates the mandatory { success: false, message, errors: [] } shape for a validation failure.
A CANDIDATE token hitting an ADMIN-only route.
Run this LAST. Closing earlier would block the Invite/Attempt/Evaluation steps above, which all require the assessment to still be PUBLISHED.
